title: System Bot and Project Manager
description: System Bot delegates the run to Project Manager. Project Manager reports plan readiness, the five Foreman worker pools, verification, and final handoff back to System Bot.

messages.text: Hi Project Manager, the user has submitted a build request. I am assigning you as supervisor to coordinate the full build process.

messages.systemLog: Send message: System Bot sends the build request and image path to Project Manager.

messages.text: Understood. I will start the build process. Since I only have the image path for now, I need to request a blueprint from Designer first.

messages.systemLog: Send message: Project Manager asks Designer to convert the image into a blueprint.

messages.text: Designer returned placements.jsonl, stage_preview.schem, and uncertainty notes. I am planning five Foreman packets: A through E.

messages.systemLog: Receive message: Project Manager receives the blueprint files and uncertainty notes from Designer.

messages.text: Foreman dispatch is ready: Foreman-A through Foreman-E, five worker-pool rooms, and 100 total workers. Each pool will report aggregate progress and exceptions only.

messages.systemLog: Prepare dispatch: Project Manager divides the blueprint into five Foreman packets and assigns 20 workers to each pool.

messages.text: Final audit passed. The world diff matches the blueprint after approved fixes, and no temporary tags remain in the exported schematic.

messages.systemLog: Verify result: Project Manager confirms the final world matches the blueprint and passes the audit.

messages.text: Returning final_world.schem, report.json, replay.jsonl, logs/*.log, and the original input metadata to System Bot for the user-facing completion message.

messages.systemLog: Send message: Project Manager sends the final files and run metadata back to System Bot.
